subject: pharmacology
title: CNS stimulants, ADHD and narcolepsy

steps.tx: **ADHD** (inattention with hyperactivity impairing school, comorbidity with tics and anxiety) is treated by **methylphenidate** (dopamine noradrenaline reuptake, appetite and sleep watched, drug holidays debated) or **atomoxetine** (selective noradrenaline, tics safer, suicidal ideation boxed, slower onset); guanfacine extended release suits tics and aggression. Diagnosis excludes thyroid, anaemia and sleep apnoea; behavioural therapy pairs. Cardiovascular screen (murmur, family sudden death) precedes stimulants.
steps.say: School impairing inattention with hyperactivity is ADHD: methylphenidate first, atomoxetine with tics. Hearts screened first.

vis.alt: Diagram showing a synapse with dopamine and noradrenaline reuptake. Methylphenidate blocks both; atomoxetine blocks noradrenaline reuptake.
vis.caption: ADHD drug mechanisms: Reuptake inhibition of dopamine and noradrenaline

steps.tx: **Stimulant cautions** (growth slowing, insomnia, appetite loss, **diversion** and misuse, psychosis at dose, seizures lowered threshold) are managed by lowest effective dose with holidays, locked storage and prescription monitoring; **tics** worsen on stimulants favouring atomoxetine or guanfacine. Blood pressure with weight charts follow; substance misuse history favours nonstimulants. Teachers rate progress blinded.
steps.say: Stimulants stunt appetite and sleep: holidays with locked cupboards. Tics worsen: atomoxetine instead.

steps.tx: **Narcolepsy** (hypocretin orexin loss, **cataplexy** laughing into weakness, sleep paralysis with hypnagogic hallucinations, MSLT early REM) is kept awake by **modafinil** (eugeroic, no euphoria, contraceptive failure caution) or pitolisant, with **sodium oxybate** nights consolidating sleep and cataplexy; amphetamines legacy. Driving licensed restricted; scheduled naps help. Idiopathic hypersomnia (long unrefreshing sleep) differs without cataplexy.
steps.say: Laughing into weakness with dream intrusions is narcolepsy: modafinil days, oxybate nights. Pills fail contraception: warn.

steps.tx: **Caffeine** (adenosine antagonism, neonatal **apnoea** treated, withdrawal headaches) and **theophylline** (narrow index, seizures, CYP interactions) stimulate modestly; **cocaine** (vasospasm MI with excited delirium, chest pain benzodiazepines not beta blockers, rhabdomyolysis) harms acutely. **Nootropics** (piracetam and analogues, evidence thin, myoclonus niche) are counselled realistically. Energy drinks stack caffeine with taurine risking arrhythmia.
steps.say: Neonatal apnoea of prematurity is caffeine territory. Cocaine chest pain never gets beta blockers.
